EmailTemplate.description: IOC Action Plan Notification email template, to owners
EmailTemplate.name: IOC_ActionPlanNotificationTemplate
EmailTemplate.subject: Action Plan Notification
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi Team,
An action is assigned to you, for the flight # {!Event__c.FlightNumber__c} from {!Event__c.DeparturePort__c} to {!Event__c.ArrivalPort__c}. Please complete the action to closed the event.
Open the link for further details: {!Event__c.Link}
Thanks, Qantas Operations
